headline: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

meeting.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meeting.summary: The committee voted 6–2 to recommend an East Maui Regional Community Board appointment and deferred a safe parking pilot project update.
meeting.recap: The agenda had two items: an East Maui board appointment and a safe parking pilot update.[[0:04:15]] Resolution 25-50 names the Hawaiian Homes Commission's representative to the board for a term ending March 31, 2030.[[1:15:41]] The committee voted six to two, with one member excused, to recommend approving the appointment.[[2:02:27]] The resolution now goes to the full council.[[2:02:34]] The committee chair said a 2022 ordinance created a pilot letting houseless people sleep in vehicles on chosen county property.[[2:03:59]] The mayor's homeless coordinator said the team is actively scouting sites but had nothing specific to report yet.[[2:06:34]] The committee chair said the item would be deferred so it can be discussed at more length later.[[3:15:41]]
decided: The chair said the item would be deferred for a longer discussion.
meeting.next: A council member suggested a committee site visit to a Molokaʻi safe sleeping site.

issues.oneLine: The committee reviewed Resolution 25-50, which appoints the Hawaiian Homes Commission's representative to the East Maui Regional Community Board.

deadlines.t: End of the Hawaiian Homes Commission representative's term under Resolution 25-50.

issues.next: The resolution now goes to the full council.
issues.brief: The nominee said the board's charter mandate is to acquire East Maui's water delivery systems and water licenses.[[#1]] The nominee said the Department of Land and Natural Resources proposed a 30-year water license to the current operator late last year.[[#2]] The nominee said stream flows in Hawaiʻi have reached record lows.[[#3]]

issues.why: The chair said that without the ordinance, state law bars living in vehicles parked on public property between 6 p.m. and 6 a.m.
issues.next: The item was deferred for a longer discussion.
